clock_source.method: Exact directed teams and UTC scheduled clock against frozen board, with explicit CBS/NCAA alias normalization. The NCAA schedule corroborates scheduled times and may be updated. Reconcile postponements or clock conflicts before grading. Actual first play is distinct.

grading: Grade only corroborated kickoff rows with a qualified official directed final. Hold any documented schedule conflict until resolved. Join directed ID to qualified official away/home final scores. Spread uses selected team final margin plus frozen line. Moneyline uses selected team final margin. Total uses final points minus line for over and line minus final points for under. Negative grade loses 500 cents. Push refunds. Win profit equals round-half-up(50000 / abs(negative American odds)) or 5 * positive American odds, in cents. Preserve fixed denominators and report any remaining final or timing gaps.

clock_conflict.note: School preview headline says 7:30 ET but event detail gives 7:32 ET. Hold under the same rule used for comparable historical conflicts.
